target.statement: Average comparisons per successful lookup for list chaining under forced-bucket stress (5×10^5 keys, 8 hot bins, seed 1) is ~31,250
target.dataset: synthetic forced-bucket keys (BBBB:seq:suffix), 5×10^5 keys, 8 hot bins

compute.basis: Small C benchmark (5e5 keys, 4096 buckets) built with make; the comparison counter is deterministic and the list-stress run is the slowest phase (~5 min on the M4 Pro, likely a few minutes on a laptop CPU).

title: When to Treeify Hash Table Buckets: A Reproducible C Study of List, Hybrid, and Red-Black Tree Chaining
